digest: 8th grade families: Credo High School holds its open house on Nov. 7th, and advance registration is required: details and sign-up. There is also a contest circulating with a grand prize of $1,000 in school supplies plus a pizza party for the class. And if you can help on Nov. 12, volunteers are needed to assemble furniture and set up rooms for new occupants.
